commands.note: 51 focused tests: identity lock contract, enrollment service, publish reconciliation, H2 slot query regression, and 4 real PostgreSQL concurrency tests

coverage_evidence: Single and bulk enrollment acquire active student identity row locks before conflict, capacity, and insert operations; batch input order is normalized by publicId.
Two overlapping PostgreSQL transactions for one student commit only one enrollment; opposite multi-student lock orders complete without deadlock.
Half-open boundary windows can both enroll the same student, and same-session retry preserves one enrollment.
Publish maps enrolled/alreadyEnrolled to ENROLLED, maps skippedByConflict to EXCLUDED with SCHEDULE_OVERLAP and conflicting session metadata, and keeps all-conflict sessions READY with 409.
Focused unit tests cover active identity lock validation and publish success, partial conflict, all-conflict, and already-enrolled branches.
limitations: No live production, deployment, browser, or full-repository regression verification is claimed.
The PostgreSQL evidence uses an isolated scratch container at 127.0.0.1:55439 and does not touch the pte-postgres application container.
